title: Illumina GUIDE-seq NGS Preparation Protocol
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Define protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required protocol parameters in the OT App as prompted (the protocol supports up to 16 samples).

steps.title: Download and unzip files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and select your labware definition files with .json extensions, if needed.

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Upload the protocol file with a .py extension to the OT App in the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate your labware, tip rack, and pipette using the OT App (refer to the support articles for calibration tips).

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” to start the semi‑automated Illumina GUIDE‑seq NGS library preparation; the user will be prompted to move the plate to and from a thermal cycler at various points.
